rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is true most of the time or in most cases.

example.english: I mostly stay home on Saturdays.
example.traditional: 我多數星期六留喺屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 do1 sou3 sing1 kei4 luk6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when mostly refers to the greater part of a group, amount, or set of people or things.

example.english: These students mostly live in Kowloon.
example.traditional: 呢班學生大部分都住喺九龍。
example.jyutping: nei1 baan1 hok6 saang1 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the main activity, reason, or characteristic rather than a numerical majority.

example.english: I work this job mostly to support my family.
example.traditional: 我返呢份工主要係為咗養屋企人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 ni1 fan6 gung1 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 wai6 zo2 joeng5 uk1 kei2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a broad ‘basically’ or ‘on the whole’ sense that allows some exceptions.

example.english: It's mostly fine; it's just a little slow.
example.traditional: 基本上冇問題，係有少少慢啫。
example.jyutping: gei1 bun2 soeng6 mou5 man6 tai4 hai6 jau5 siu2 siu2 maan6 ze1
